subject.title: [Feature]: Expose an inbound non-message event hook to external channel plugins (e.g. reactions)

question: Should external channel plugins surface non-message activity through existing system-event/inbound-runner APIs, or should OpenClaw add a new public channel event hook or adapter contract?
rationale: The code proves a real SDK/documentation gap, but choosing the permanent plugin API shape affects third-party compatibility and overlaps with the open `inbound_activity` hook proposal.

options.title: Document the existing system-event path
options.body: Treat reactions and similar notifications as routed system events, document the channel-plugin recipe, and add code only if that recipe proves insufficient.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow event hook
options.body: Define a typed Plugin SDK hook or channel adapter for non-message inbound activity and coordinate it with PR #79855 before merging implementation work.

options.title: Defer for concrete plugin proof
options.body: Ask for a minimal Zoho Cliq plugin sketch showing why system events and `runChannelInboundEvent` cannot satisfy the use case before expanding the SDK.

recommendation.title: Document the existing system-event path
recommendation.body: Treat reactions and similar notifications as routed system events, document the channel-plugin recipe, and add code only if that recipe proves insufficient.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant history points to steipete across SDK/channel runtime docs and plugin API seams, making him the best available routing owner for the API direction choice.
